note: The companion's daily routine for the Companion Runtime. Authoring source for lib/presentation/companion/runtime/daily_routine.dart; daily_routine_parity_test.dart asserts the two agree field for field. A step names an interaction-point role and a specific furniture action id, and that action must also carry the 'routine' trigger in furniture_catalog.dart - so this table and the catalog have to agree. The routine does not invent behaviour: it selects among behaviours the catalog already declares. It is presentation-only and can never reach XP, coins or a settlement. lateNight is deliberately absent: the night rule in furniture_action_resolver.dart already owns bedtime, and a second answer to 'when does it sleep' would be two sources of truth.
